_doc: Floors (generation only grows): generative_share, planes, trigger_share.
Equality (ground truth, never moves): total -- the tune's own write count. A share
whose denominator can move is not a ratchet: #117's artifact briefly lost 6492 writes
from its books and every percentage rose. Asserted by ==, not by a bound.
Recorded context, asserted by nothing: observed_fires, recover_s.
Loosening a bound is a deliberate, reviewable diff line, not a refactor's side effect.
planes floors Coverage.planes generated-per-plane, so a gain in one plane can no
longer mask a loss in another; the key set is exact, because which planes exist is
fixed by the tune's emits rather than by how well they are recovered.
observed_fires is context, not a ceiling: a RAW-replayed byte carries no trigger and a
generated one needs one, so converting residual into generation RAISES it wherever the
new trigger is an EDGE. trigger_share (Coverage.triggers, generated/all) is the floor
that replaces it: it cannot be gamed by generating less.
Shares are floored at 6dp, never rounded: 0.941925926 records as 0.941925, because a
rounded-up floor fails >= on the very run that measured it.

baseline.records: the delivered state, not a starting point: bounds re-measured after #117 so its gains are held by CI
baseline.jitter: none: every figure reproduced exactly on two independent runs, so the bounds sit at the measured value with no margin

tunes.measured: 3101/3375 canonical entries survive ablation. #117 moved nothing in the value domain here (the turning sweep does not run this early); its trigger_share 0 -> 0.204205 and observed fires 2071 -> 1968 are what show at 400
tunes.frames_why: 400 is where each structure recurs rather than happening once: orderlist cursor $54EC takes 3 values (2 advances), pattern cursor $54EF resets twice, and the $10 pulse ramp runs segments of up to 24 emits at step 22 over bound 256 (2 full turns). At 200 each of the three occurs exactly once; the full tune's 11750 frames is ~236s and far too slow for CI

tunes.measured: 9821/10489 survive ablation. This entry is where #117 shows: share 0.872533 -> 0.936314, residual 1337 -> 668, pw 900 -> 1569, shallow 1013 -> 991, trigger_share 0 -> 0.176914
tunes.frames_why: the 400-frame entry cannot see the pulse-width sweep at all: Commando's turning instruments enter around frame 800, so pw holds 407/485 = 84% at 400 and 708/844 = 84% at 700, then knees to 600/1008 = 60% at 800 and 900/2115 = 43% here, where pw's 1215 residual is 91% of the tune's whole 1337. Sweeping 400..11750 (pw bottoms at 8492/31563 = 27%, residual 23071 of 25763, ~236s), 1200 is the smallest count that registers work of this size: against the in-flight pulse sweep it moves pw 900 -> 1569 and residual 1337 -> 668, where 400 moves neither by a single emit and 800 moves pw by 2. Costs 2.6s to recover, against ~76s at 7200

tunes.measured: 880/2099 survive ablation, unchanged by #117: a second engine holding still is the control on Commando's gain
tunes.frames_why: a second engine at the same frame count; mid-range share, so movement in either direction is visible where Commando's 0.92 has little room left. It carries no pw plane at all -- its 1170 residual is mostly filter 0/802 -- so it locks the planes Commando's entries cannot
